title: 111. How do I change my email address?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I change my email address.
short_answer: If you access EUSurvey using an EU Login user account, you cannot change your email address in EUSurvey. Instead, connect to EU Login and after login, select 'Modify my personal data' from the 'Account information' tab.
procedure: If you use the OSS version of EUSurvey or you're a business user of the API interface, please connect to the application. Under 'Settings' > 'My Account' > click on 'E-mail'.
